compiled_state.title: [.test-index]: Multiple entries per file accepted -> suite-engine last-entry-wins silently breaks RED zone
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** f371c3c092

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

.test-index should enforce at most one entry per unique (source-file, test-file) pairing. The suite-engine reads _RED_MARKER_MAP with last-entry-wins semantics, so multiple entries for the same test file silently override each other, leaving only the last one active. The contract should be enforced at write time (pre-commit hook or validation script) so that incorrect multi-entry patterns are caught before they reach CI.

#### Actual Behavior

During debug session on 2026-05-06, four extra RED marker entries were added to .test-index for test-enforcement-gate.sh (one per structural-check test), alongside the correct single anchor entry. Because last-entry-wins, only the last entry (test_structural_check_referential_integrity_runs_on_ci) was active as the RED zone boundary. Tests 1–4 fell before the boundary and were not tolerated, causing 5 test failures in CI Hook Tests.

The `test-check-test-index-duplicates.sh` test auto-unions duplicate source-file keys but does not detect or reject duplicate test-file keys (the [test_name] form). There is no gate preventing this class of misconfiguration.

comments.body:
Investigated: confirmed bug. The bash-runner _RED_MARKER_MAP at plugins/dso/scripts/runners/bash-runner.sh:193-195 sets last-entry-wins on test-file path. The existing check-test-index-duplicates.sh auto-unions same-source-key duplicates and same-test-file-within-line duplicates, but does NOT detect cross-source-key, same-test-file with different markers (the 804a-84c7 scenario).

Attempted fix (reverted): added a cross-line marker-conflict detector that exits 1 when the same test file appears with conflicting markers across multiple source-key lines. This conflicted with 5 existing test fixtures that exercise the auto-union path for cross-line duplicates with same source key — those tests ARE the intentional case the union resolves.

Right design probably: run the union FIRST, then apply the cross-line detector to the post-union state (where remaining cross-line duplicates can only differ by source key, never by source key + test file). That requires restructuring check-test-index-duplicates.sh to run union → detect → fail/auto-stage in three phases. Out of scope for this session; needs a fresh design pass.

Workaround for now: agents adding RED markers must consolidate same-test-file entries to a single line manually.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Fixed: Added cross-source-key RED marker conflict detection to check-test-index-duplicates.sh. A new _check_cross_key_conflicts function scans for the same test file appearing under multiple source-key lines each with a different RED marker — the bash-runner last-entry-wins bug. The check runs both in the fast path (no source-key dups) and after auto-union (for cases where dups existed). On conflict, exits 1 with an error listing the conflicting entries and source keys. Tests without markers are not affected. Added 4 new behavioral tests covering: fast-path rejection, no-marker same-test-file allowed, post-union detection, and combined dup+conflict scenario.
